question: Which of the following events occurred in 1919?

options.text: Representation of the People Act was passed
Suppression of Fraud and Dacoity Act passed

solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyagraha against Rowlatt Act**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Satyagraha against Rowlatt Act** occurred in **1919**.
 
• The Rowlatt Act, passed by the British government, aimed to **extend emergency measures and curb nationalist activities**.
